requirements.normative_requirement: D0 operations are mechanically read-only, replay-safe, and may use volatile admission.
requirements.threat_or_failure: D0 latency destroyed by durable writes or hidden mutation
requirements.primary_verification: Read-only enforcement proof, daemon restart repeat, and fsync tracing.

requirements.normative_requirement: D1 admission is durably committed before workspace mutation or arbitrary process start.
requirements.primary_verification: Crash before/after D1 admission and verify no effect before durable state.

requirements.normative_requirement: D2 external-effect operations require durable pre-dispatch intent before bytes can leave; D2 is disabled in Release 0.1.
requirements.primary_verification: Profile/compiler test proving D2 cannot be constructed in Release 0.1.

requirements.normative_requirement: D0 retries cannot mutate or advance workspace generation.
requirements.primary_verification: Read-only mount/RPC negative canaries and TLA+ invariant.

requirements.normative_requirement: Ordinary D0 telemetry performs no per-call FULL-durability database transaction or fsync.
requirements.threat_or_failure: Million-call hot path performs synchronous storage
requirements.primary_verification: Syscall trace plus million-D0-call benchmark and bounded audit overflow test.
